title: Visual validate soft flashlight falloff
objective: Run a tmux-managed short orbit render validation for the soft co-located flashlight profile, focusing on scene-off flashlight-off versus scene-off flashlight-on output.
instructions: Create a timestamped run directory under .control-tower/runs/ for logs, runner script, and a two-setting light JSON containing only scene_off_flashlight_off with spawn_flashlight=false/enabled=false/intensity=0 and scene_off_flashlight_on with scene_lights_enabled=false/enabled=true/intensity=1200.
Launch the render in a named tmux session/window and report the exact tmux attach command.

Use examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh render with the existing examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json, the two-setting light JSON from the run directory, and output directory examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_soft_falloff_validation.

Use the current soft defaults unless the workflow requires explicit flags; include source radius 12, soft source radius 80, inner cone 2, outer cone 60, attenuation radius 650, indirect lighting intensity 0, scene light intensity scale 0.2.
Monitor until complete, failed, or clearly blocked; preserve logs with tee/redirection in the run directory.

After completion, inspect output metadata and basic frame/luma diagnostics for both settings. Report whether scene_off_flashlight_off stays dark/no-flashlight and whether scene_off_flashlight_on appears less like a hard circular hole based on available diagnostics; if visual judgment needs human inspection, say that and provide exact video/frame paths.
constraints: Do not edit product source, tests, docs, or Git state.
Every long-running/user-observable process must run in tmux.

artifacts: examples/flashlight/README.md now documents the soft orbit flashlight profile: intensity 1200, attenuation radius 650, inner cone 2, outer cone 60, source radius 12, soft source radius 80, and indirect lighting intensity 0.

expected_outputs: Result packet with tmux attach command, run directory, log path, output video/frame paths, pass/fail status, and concrete next action if the render still looks wrong.
definition_of_done: Render completed or failed with preserved logs and actionable diagnosis.
